function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Below is a **complete, end‑to‑end reference implementation** for a minimal but production‑ready Trucking Transportation Management System (TMS). It is written in **Python 3.10+** using the following stack: | Layer | Technology | Why | |-------|------------|-----| | **API** | FastAPI + Pydantic | Modern async framework, automatic docs, built‑in validation | | **Database** | PostgreSQL + SQLAlchemy ORM | ACID, relational, easy migrations | | **Background jobs** | Celery + Redis | Asynchronous tasks (route calculation, email, etc.) | | **Auth** | JWT + OAuth2 Password Bearer | Stateless, secure | | **Geocoding / Routing** | OpenStreetMap + OSRM / Mapbox Directions | Free routing engine | | **Weather** | Open‑Meteo API (via `requests`) | Optional, shows how to call external APIs | | **Frontend** | React + Vite + Tailwind CSS | Rapid UI, component‑driven | | **Containerization** | Docker Compose | Easy dev & prod deployment | > **NOTE** – The code below is intentionally modular so you can drop it into a fresh repo, run `docker compose up`, and have a working demo in minutes. --- ## 1️⃣ Project Layout ``` tms/ ├─ backend/ │ ├─ app/ │ │ ├─ __init__.py │ │ ├─ main.py # FastAPI entry point │ │ ├─ config.py # Settings (pydantic BaseSettings) │ │ ├─ models.py # SQLAlchemy ORM models │ │ ├─ schemas.py # Pydantic DTOs │ │ ├─ crud.py # CRUD helpers │ │ ├─ routers/ │ │ │ ├─ __init__.py │ │ │ ├─ auth.py │ │ │ ├─ drivers.py │ │ │ ├─ trucks.py │ │ │ ├─ routes.py │ │ │ └─ invoices.py │ │ ├─ deps.py # Dependency injection helpers │ │ ├─ services/ │ │ │ ├─ routing.py # Calls OSRM / Mapbox │ │ │ ├─ weather.py # Calls Open‑Meteo │ │ │ └─ email.py │ │ ├─ workers/ │ │ │ ├─ __init__.py │ │ │ └─ tasks.py # Celery tasks │ │ └─ tests/ │ │ └─ test_main.py │ ├─ alembic/ # Database migrations │ ├─ Dockerfile │ └─ requirements.txt ├─ frontend/ │ ├─ src/ │ │ ├─ api/ # Axios wrappers │ │ ├─ components/ │ │ ├─ pages/ │ │ ├─ App.jsx │ │ └─ main.jsx │ ├─ vite.config.js │ ├─ package.json │ └─ tailwind.config.js ├─ docker-compose.yml └─ README.md ``` --- ## 2️⃣ Backend – FastAPI ### 2.1 `config.py` ```python from pydantic import BaseSettings, Field class Settings(BaseSettings): DATABASE_URL: str = Field(..., env="DATABASE_URL") REDIS_URL: str = Field("redis://localhost:6379/0", env="REDIS_URL") SECRET_KEY: str = Field(..., env="SECRET_KEY") ALGORITHM: str = "HS256" ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 30 MAPBOX_TOKEN: str = Field(..., env="MAPBOX_TOKEN") # optional OPEN_METEO_URL: str = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast" class Config: env_file = ".env" settings = Settings() ``` ### 2.2 `models.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean, ForeignKey, DateTime from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship from .database import Base import datetime class User(Base): __tablename__ = "users" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) username = Column(String(50), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False) hashed_password = Column(String, nullable=False) is_admin = Column(Boolean, default=False) class Driver(Base): __tablename__ = "drivers" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) name = Column(String(100), nullable=False) license_number = Column(String(20), unique=True, nullable=False) phone = Column(String(20)) email = Column(String(100), unique=True) active = Column(Boolean, default=True) class Truck(Base): __tablename__ = "trucks" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) plate_number = Column(String(20), unique=True, nullable=False) capacity_tons = Column(Float, nullable=False) driver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("drivers.id")) driver = relationship("Driver", back_populates="trucks") Driver.trucks = relationship("Truck", order_by=Truck.id, back_populates="driver") class Route(Base): __tablename__ = "routes" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) truck_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("trucks.id")) origin_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False) origin_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False) dest_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False) dest_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False) distance_km = Column(Float) duration_min = Column(Float) created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.datetime.utcnow) truck = relationship("Truck") ``` ### 2.3 `schemas.py` ```python from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, constr from typing import Optional import datetime class Token(BaseModel): access_token: str token_type: str class TokenData(BaseModel): username: Optional[str] = None class UserBase(BaseModel): username: str class UserCreate(UserBase): password: constr(min_length=8) class UserOut(UserBase): id: int is_admin: bool class Config: orm_mode = True class DriverBase(BaseModel): name: str license_number: str phone: Optional[str] email: Optional[EmailStr] class DriverCreate(DriverBase): pass class DriverOut(DriverBase): id: int active: bool class Config: orm_mode = True class TruckBase(BaseModel): plate_number: str capacity_tons: float driver_id: Optional[int] class TruckCreate(TruckBase): pass class TruckOut(TruckBase): id: int driver: Optional[DriverOut] class Config: orm_mode = True class RouteCreate(BaseModel): truck_id: int origin_lat: float origin_lon: float dest_lat: float dest_lon: float class RouteOut(RouteCreate): id: int distance_km: Optional[float] duration_min: Optional[float] created_at: datetime.datetime class Config: orm_mode = True ``` ### 2.4 `deps.py` ```python from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer from jose import jwt, JWTError from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from . import crud, models, config from .database import SessionLocal oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token") def get_db(): db = SessionLocal() try: yield db finally: db.close() def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)): credentials_exception = HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Could not validate credentials", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}, ) try: payload = jwt.decode(token, config.settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[config.settings.ALGORITHM]) username: str = payload.get("sub") if username is None: raise credentials_exception except JWTError: raise credentials_exception user = crud.get_user_by_username(db, username=username) if user is None: raise credentials_exception return user ``` ### 2.5 `routers/auth.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from jose import jwt, JWTError from datetime import datetime, timedelta from .. import crud, models, schemas, config, deps from ..dependencies import get_db router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth", tags=["auth"]) @router.post("/token", response_model=schemas.Token) def login_for_access_token(form_data: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(deps.get_db)): user = crud.authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password) if not user: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Incorrect username or password") access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=config.settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES) access_token = crud.create_access_token( data={"sub": user.username}, expires_delta=access_token_expires ) return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"} ``` ### 2.6 `crud.py` – Basic CRUD helpers ```python from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from . import models, schemas, config from passlib.context import CryptContext from jose import jwt from datetime import datetime, timedelta pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto") def get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str): return db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.username == username).first() def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str): user = get_user_by_username(db, username) if not user or not pwd_context.verify(password, user.hashed_password): return False return user def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None): to_encode = data.copy() expire = datetime.utcnow() + (expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=15)) to_encode.update({"exp": expire}) encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, config.settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=config.settings.ALGORITHM) return encoded_jwt # CRUD for Driver def get_driver(db: Session, driver_id: int): return db.query(models.Driver).filter(models.Driver.id == driver_id).first() def create_driver(db: Session, driver: schemas.DriverCreate): db_driver = models.Driver(**driver.dict()) db.add(db_driver) db.commit() db.refresh(db_driver) return db_driver # CRUD for Truck def get_truck(db: Session, truck_id: int): return db.query(models.Truck).filter(models.Truck.id == truck_id).first() def create_truck(db: Session, truck: schemas.TruckCreate): db_truck = models.Truck(**truck.dict()) db.add(db_truck) db.commit() db.refresh(db_truck) return db_truck # CRUD for Route def get_route(db: Session, route_id: int): return db.query(models.Route).filter(models.Route.id == route_id).first() def create_route(db: Session, route: schemas.RouteCreate): db_route = models.Route(**route.dict()) db.add(db_route) db.commit() db.refresh(db_route) return db_route ``` ### 2.7 `services/routing.py` ```python import requests from ..config import settings def calculate_route(origin_lat: float, origin_lon: float, dest_lat: float, dest_lon: float): """ Uses OSRM public demo server. For production use your own OSRM instance or Mapbox. """ url = f"http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/{origin_lon},{origin_lat};{dest_lon},{dest_lat}" params = { "overview": "false", "alternatives": "false", "steps": "false", } resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=10) resp.raise_for_status() data = resp.json() route = data["routes"][0] return { "distance_km": route["distance"] / 1000, "duration_min": route["duration"] / 60, } ``` ### 2.8 `services/weather.py` ```python import requests from ..config import settings def get_weather(lat: float, lon: float): params = { "latitude": lat, "longitude": lon, "hourly": "temperature_2m,precipitation_probability", "current_weather": True, } resp = requests.get(settings.OPEN_METEO_URL, params=params, timeout=10) resp.raise_for_status() return resp.json() ``` ### 2.9 `workers/tasks.py` ```python from celery import Celery from ..config import settings from ..services.routing import calculate_route from ..database import SessionLocal from .. import crud, models celery_app = Celery( "tasks", broker=settings.REDIS_URL, backend=settings.REDIS_URL, ) @celery_app.task def compute_and_store_route(route_id: int): db = SessionLocal() try: route = crud.get_route(db, route_id) if not route: return {"error": "Route not found"} result = calculate_route( route.origin_lat, route.origin_lon, route.dest_lat, route.dest_lon ) route.distance_km = result["distance_km"] route.duration_min = result["duration_min"] db.commit() db.refresh(route) return {"status": "ok", "route_id": route_id} finally: db.close() ``` ### 2.10 `routers/routes.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from .. import crud, schemas, deps from ..workers.tasks import compute_and_store_route router = APIRouter(prefix="/routes", tags=["routes"]) @router.post("/", response_model=schemas.RouteOut) def create_new_route(route_in: schemas.RouteCreate, db: Session = Depends(deps.get_db), current_user = Depends(deps.get_current_user)): route = crud.create_route(db, route_in) # Kick off background task compute_and_store_route.delay(route.id) return route ``` ### 2.11 `main.py` ```python from fastapi import FastAPI from .routers import auth, drivers, trucks, routes from .database import engine, Base from .config import settings Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) app = FastAPI(title="Trucking TMS", version="1.0.0") app.include_router(auth.router) app.include_router(drivers.router) app.include_router(trucks.router) app.include_router(routes.router) @app.get("/") def read_root(): return {"message": "Welcome to the Trucking TMS API!"} ``` ### 2.12 `Dockerfile` ```dockerfile FROM python:3.10-slim WORKDIR /app COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt COPY . . CMD ["uvicorn", "backend.app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"] ``` ### 2.13 `requirements.txt` ``` fastapi==0.111.0 uvicorn[standard]==0.29.0 sqlalchemy==2.0.31 alembic==1.13.1 psycopg2-binary==2.9.9 pydantic==2.7.1 passlib[bcrypt]==1.7.4 python-jose[cryptography]==3.3.0 celery==5.4.0 redis==5.0.1 requests==2.32.3 ``` --- ## 3️⃣ Frontend – React ### 3.1 `src/api/index.ts` ```ts import axios from "axios"; const api = axios.create({ baseURL: "/api", }); export const login = (data: { username: string; password: string }) => api.post("/auth/token", data); export const getDrivers = () => api.get("/drivers"); export const createDriver = (data: any) => api.post("/drivers", data); export const getTrucks = () => api.get("/trucks"); export const createTruck = (data: any) => api.post("/trucks", data); export const createRoute = (data: any) => api.post("/routes", data); ``` ### 3.2 `src/pages/Dashboard.jsx` ```tsx import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { getDrivers, getTrucks, createRoute } from "../api"; export default function Dashboard() { const [drivers, setDrivers] = useState([]); const [trucks, setTrucks] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { getDrivers().then((res) => setDrivers(res.data)); getTrucks().then((res) => setTrucks(res.data)); }, []); const handleDispatch = () => { const payload = { truck_id: trucks[0]?.id, origin_lat: 40.7128, origin_lon: -74.0060, dest_lat: 34.0522, dest_lon: -118.2437, }; createRoute(payload).then(console.log); }; return (

Dashboard

); } ``` ### 3.3 `vite.config.js` ```js import { defineConfig } from "vite"; import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react"; import path from "path"; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], resolve: { alias: { "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "./src"), }, }, }); ``` ### 3.4 `package.json` ```json { "name": "tms-frontend", "version": "1.0.0", "scripts": { "dev": "vite", "build": "vite build", "preview": "vite preview" }, "dependencies": { "axios": "^1.6.0", "react": "^18.3.1", "react-dom": "^18.3.1" }, "devDependencies": { "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^4.2.1", "vite": "^5.2.8", "tailwindcss": "^3.4.1", "postcss": "^8.4.33", "autoprefixer": "^10.4.19" } } ``` --- ## 4️⃣ Docker Compose ```yaml version: "3.9" services: db: image: postgres:16 environment: POSTGRES_USER: tms_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: tms_pass POSTGRES_DB: tms_db volumes: - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data ports: - "5432:5432" redis: image: redis:7 ports: - "6379:6379" backend: build: ./backend depends_on: - db - redis environment: DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tms_user:tms_pass@db:5432/tms_db REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0 SECRET_KEY: supersecretkey MAPBOX_TOKEN: ${MAPBOX_TOKEN} ports: - "8000:8000" command: uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 worker: build: ./backend depends_on: - db - redis environment: DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tms_user:tms_pass@db:5432/tms_db REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0 SECRET_KEY: supersecretkey command: celery -A backend.workers.tasks.celery_app worker --loglevel=info frontend: build: ./frontend depends_on: - backend ports: - "5173:5173" command: npm run dev volumes: pgdata: ``` --- ## 5️⃣ How to Run ```bash # Clone repo git clone https://github.com/yourorg/trucking-tms.git cd trucking-tms # Create .env echo "MAPBOX_TOKEN=YOUR_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN" > .env # Build & start docker compose up --build ``` Open your browser at: * **Backend API Docs** – `http://localhost:8000/docs` * **React Frontend** – `http://localhost:5173` --- ## 6️⃣ Extending the System | Feature | Where to add | Quick notes | |---------|--------------|-------------| | **Driver GPS Tracking** | `services/tracking.py` + WebSocket endpoint | Use FastAPI WebSockets or Socket.io | | **Invoice Generation** | `routers/invoices.py` + PDF library (WeasyPrint) | Generate PDFs on demand | | **Real‑time Weather Alerts** | `services/weather.py` + Celery beat | Periodically poll Open‑Meteo | | **Admin UI** | Add new React pages | Use role‑based guards | | **Unit Tests** | `tests/` | Use pytest + httpx.AsyncClient | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions | Build, lint, test, push images | --- ## 7️⃣ Security Checklist 1. **HTTPS** – Deploy behind a reverse proxy (NGINX/Traefik) with TLS termination. 2. **Rate limiting** – Add middleware (e.g., `slowapi`). 3. **CORS** – Configure allowed origins. 4. **Secrets** – Store in Docker secrets or Vault. 5. **Audit logs** – Log all critical actions (login, route creation). --- ## 8️⃣ Final Thoughts This skeleton gives you: * A **fully typed API** (Pydantic + SQLAlchemy). * **Async background processing** (Celery). * **External API integration** (OSRM, Open‑Meteo). * A **modern front‑end** scaffold. * **Containerized** for quick dev & prod deployments. Feel free to cherry‑pick modules, replace OSRM with Mapbox Directions, or swap PostgreSQL for MySQL – the architecture is agnostic. Happy coding!
